plan: With a private value of $13, my optimal strategy is to bid strategically. Since the winner pays the second-highest bid, I want to maximize my potential profit. I'll bid slightly below my true value to ensure I can potentially win while minimizing overpayment. My private value is $9. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. Bidding less risks losing when I could have won, while bidding more doesn't improve my expected outcome. Since the values are independently drawn, I can't infer others' values. I'll bid my true value of $9, which maximizes my potential profit by ensuring I win if my value is highest while minimizing overpayment.
